languages.text: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

text.formatted: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.
text.plain: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and Unconscious while poisoned in this way.
